request.style: English, intimate acoustic singer-songwriter, honest male vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft cajon, cello, light harmonies, reflective and hopeful, 86 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
All night we fished on Gennesaret and the nets came up bare
He said put out into the deep and let them down from there
So full of fish the nets were tearing, both boats began to sink
I fell down at his knees and I could hardly speak or think

[Chorus]
Simon son of John, do you love me
Yes, Lord
You know that I love you
Feed my lambs
Take care of my sheep
Follow me, follow me

[Verse]
In the fourth watch of the night we saw him walking on the sea
I asked him, call me out to you, and Come, he said to me
I walked on the water till I saw how strong the wind could be
Then sinking down I cried, Lord, save me, and he reached his hand to me

[Chorus]
Simon son of John, do you love me
Yes, Lord
You know that I love you
Feed my lambs
Take care of my sheep
Follow me, follow me

[Verse]
By the fire in the courtyard a servant girl looked at my face
I don't know him, I said, three times I fell from grace
The rooster crowed, the Lord turned round and looked straight at me
And I went out into the night and wept so bitterly

[Bridge]
Three times I said I don't know him
Three times he asked me, do you love me
Lord, you know everything
You know that I love you

[Chorus]
Simon son of John, do you love me
Yes, Lord
You know that I love you
Feed my lambs
Take care of my sheep
Follow me, follow me

[Outro]
Follow me
